eyebrow: The vault stays the source of truth
caption: A controller watches this resource and keeps the Kubernetes Secret synced from Vault automatically — no manual copy step.

code:
jobs:
  deploy:
    steps:
      - name: Deploy checkout service
        env:
          DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DB_PASSWORD }}

caption: GitHub Actions masks any logged value matching a referenced secret — a safety net, not a substitute for never printing one on purpose.
